build_hosts_required.macos: Apple Silicon macOS with the pinned build environment

release_licensing.generated_outputs: Users may freely use, modify, and redistribute outputs generated by the software; no ownership is claimed over user inputs or generated outputs.

product_surface.language: English only; no runtime language selector

designer_source.release_source_tree_hash_method: SHA-256 over each sorted UTF-8 relative path, a NUL separator, and its file contents, excluding __pycache__ and .pyc files
designer_source.private_engine_policy: Used only by DNA Moire Designer; never replaced by companion cadnano.

extension_scope: preserve and restore scaffold_sequences at exact 5-prime anchors
preserve scaffold colors, lattice and num_bases

latest_designer_sync.workflow_invalidation: Editing accepted design, scaffold, or SST-input assignments revokes the affected acceptance state and all downstream state.
latest_designer_sync.structure_report_layout: The Step 2 design report is a full-width, vertically resizable bottom row using the Step 3 report typography.
latest_designer_sync.normal_staple_histogram: All nonzero decimal-percentage bins are displayed, including values below 1%.
latest_designer_sync.mixed_lattice_input_mapping: Square--Kagome linked layer lengths retain independent SST-input assignments because the layer topologies differ.
latest_designer_sync.cross_platform_ocr: Tesseract is resolved through the packaged runtime on Windows and macOS; the bundled tessdata directory is configured when present.

spacing_domain_indel_limits.rule: For N nominal 8-bp spacing domains, deletion is bounded by -3N and insertion by min(3N, 10).
spacing_domain_indel_limits.zero_spacing_linkage: A 0-bp spacing fixes Twist and mean insertion/deletion at 0.
spacing_domain_indel_limits.scaffold_capacity_preflight: The UI rejects insertion requests that exceed the selected fixed-scaffold routing headroom before structure generation.
spacing_domain_indel_limits.preserved_routing: The validated 0/8-bp auxiliary-helix, SST layer, input/output/capture mapping, and moment-balanced edit-distribution rules are unchanged.

release_regressions.accept_current_sst_input: Oversized sequence assignments use a temporary response file to avoid the Windows CreateProcess command-line limit.
release_regressions.cadnano_frozen_startup: All cadnano2 submodules, PyQt6.QtSvg, PyQt6.QtSvgWidgets, and official cadnano2 distribution metadata are collected; the frozen self-test initializes the complete GUI offscreen.
release_regressions.blocking_frozen_self_tests: The build waits for both GUI-subsystem self-test processes and aborts on any non-zero process exit code.
release_regressions.windows_inno_short_path_staging: The final onedir is copied to a unique short temporary source root before Inno Setup compilation, preventing failures caused by deeply nested extraction paths.
release_regressions.dependency_license_metadata_gate: Windows and macOS builds package Python distribution metadata and stop if no dependency license or notice files are present.
